description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart representing the distribution of “Task Type” in the referenced study, and it contains two slices. The larger slice is labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” and is shown in a muted red/pink color, while the smaller slice is labeled “Headline generation (16.8%)” and is shown in a pale yellow color. The chart places the title text “Task Type” in the center of the donut, and the percentages are provided as part of the external slice labels rather than inside the segments. There is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond their relative sizes.
